$comment: Ledger for RAIL-TOKEN-REFERENCE-RESOLVABILITY-01. Two-directional ratchet: the audit fails if a current finding is absent here (unledgered) OR an entry here no longer reproduces (stale), so it can only shrink truthfully. There is deliberately no re-seed script in the repo — regenerating this file from current findings would be the re-baseline escape hatch this rail replaced. Every entry is one instance of a single defect class: codegen preserves camelCase in --fsds-* names while the token build kebab-cases them. Recorded per (component, name) because that is the granularity a repair is verified at. Burn-down is owned by FIX-TOKEN-SLUG-KEBAB-CASE-01, which MUST split on repairIsValuePreserving — the 'no' entries move pixels in dark mode and need visual review, the 'yes' entries are mechanical.

gaps.name: --fsds-core-dimension-actionMinHeight
gaps.note: Codegen emits this name verbatim from the contract's camelCase resolvesTo (tokenSlug, packages/ds-codegen/src/ir.ts:4996), while the token build kebab-cases the same path to --fsds-core-dimension-action-min-height (tokenPathToCSSVar, packages/ds-tokens/build/core/index.ts:225). The names never meet, so the reference falls back to 36px. Repair is value-preserving: the graph resolves --fsds-core-dimension-action-min-height to 36px, which the fallback already renders. Latent, not cosmetic — the property is pinned to a literal and ignores any brand or theme re-point of the token.
